description:
A Windows desktop organizer with a quick launcher, clipboard history, and global search.

DustDesk is a Tauri 2 based Windows desktop efficiency tool that keeps your desktop tidy.
It organizes desktop files into category boxes with drag in, drag out, and move-back support, launches programs and files in batch, keeps text and image clipboard history behind Ctrl+Tab, and offers Ctrl+Space global search with history. It runs minimized to the system tray, and the data, organizer, and launcher directories are configurable.
